verses.text: Are we starting to praise ourselves again? Do we need letters to recommend us to you or from you, as some people do?
You yourselves are our letter, written on our hearts. Everyone can know it and read it.
You show that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our work. It is not written with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God. It is not written on tablets of stone, but on human hearts.
We can be this sure because of Christ, in front of God.
We are not able to do anything by ourselves. Our ability comes from God.
He has made us able to serve a new covenant. It is not a covenant of written law, but of the Spirit. The written law brings death, but the Spirit gives life.

The old way that brought death was carved in letters on stone, and yet it came with glory. The people of Israel could not even look at Moses' face because of its glory, even though that glory was fading.
So the work of the Spirit will have even greater glory.
The old way that brought blame had glory. So the way that makes people right with God has much more glory.
What once had glory now has no glory at all, next to the far greater glory.
If what was fading away came with glory, how much greater is the glory of what lasts for ever!
Since we have such a hope, we speak very boldly.
We are not like Moses, who put a veil over his face so that the people of Israel would not see the end of the glory that was fading away.
But their minds were closed. Even to this day the same veil stays there when the old covenant is read. It is taken away only in Christ.
Even today, when the books of Moses are read, a veil covers their hearts.
But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
The Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.
And all of us, with faces not covered, see the glory of the Lord as in a mirror. We are being changed to become more like him, with more and more glory. This comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.
